title: Write about your last weekend
writingModel: Last weekend was one of the most enjoyable weekends I have had since I arrived in Uralsk. I stayed in the city and spent time with my friends from the Economics faculty. The weather was perfect — cool and sunny — and I felt completely relaxed after a difficult week of lectures and assignments.

On Saturday morning, I cleaned my room and organised my notes. I listened to music while I worked and finished everything in about an hour. After that, I cooked a simple breakfast and called my parents in Semey. We talked for forty minutes and they asked about my studies, my food, and my friends. It was wonderful to hear their voices.

In the afternoon, I walked to the city park with three friends: Aruzhan, Saule, and Aisha. We walked along the river path, talked about our lecturers, and laughed a lot. Saule bought ice cream for everyone from a small kiosk. We stayed in the park for almost two hours. I enjoyed every minute of it — I didn't want to leave!

On Saturday evening, I cooked dinner at my room. I prepared rice with chicken — a recipe my grandmother in Semey taught me. Aruzhan sliced the bread and Aisha arranged the salad. We all ate together, listened to music, and talked loudly. After dinner, we watched a Kazakh comedy film on my laptop. Everyone laughed so much — it was a perfect evening.

On Sunday, I studied all day. I worked on my Economics essay for six hours and finished two complete sections. I also emailed my project supervisor to confirm our next meeting. It was a long day of work, but I felt satisfied when I finished. I didn't go out at all — I stayed at my desk and focused. By Sunday evening, I was tired but happy. Overall, last weekend was a great balance of fun and hard work — exactly what a university student needs.
